tags.rule: a behavioral constraint that holds whatever the user asks
tags.trigger: a "when X happens / user asks X → do Y" proactivity mapping

tags.dark: describes a feature that is off, dev-gated, or dry-run somewhere

seedDisposition.I: index line in seed + full text on demand
seedDisposition.D: on-demand detail of a parent feature (no own index line)
seedDisposition.N: history — move to a linked note

darkScope.F: dev-gated: dark on fleet, live on Echo (a development agent)
